## Colter Bay Red and White Light Experiment

First I had to create a shortcut on the shared folder in google drive to be on mydrive. I then found that shared folder on mydrive in finder and copied the location url.

```{r, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
source("01_import_sonobat.R")
```

```{r}
source("02_clean_data.R")
data <- clean_data(data_raw)
```

```{r}
source("03_extract_habitat.R")

#data_env <- add_environmental_covariates(data, forest_raster)

data_env <- add_habitat(
  data,
  forest_raster = nlcd_forest,
  buffer = 50
)

data_env <- add_moonlight(data_env)
```

```{r}
source("07_add_light_treatment.R")

data_full <- readRDS('data_full.rds')

data_env <- data_env %>%
  left_join(
    lighting %>%
      select(date, color, intensity, block),
    by = "date"
  )

data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    color = factor(color),
    site = factor(site),
    intensity = factor(intensity),
    block = factor(block)
  )
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggeffects)

pred <- ggpredict(
  models$m2,
  terms = c("jd [all]", "color", "intensity"),
  bias_correction = TRUE
)

ggplot(pred, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~facet) +
  labs(
    x = "Julian Day",
    y = "Predicted bat occurrences",
    color = "Light color"
  ) + 
  theme_classic()

ggplot(pred, aes(x=x, y=group, fill=predicted)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~facet) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  labs(
    x = "Julian Day",
    y = "Light color",
    fill = 'Predicted occurrences'
  ) +
  theme_classic()

pred_df <- as.data.frame(pred)

p1 <- ggplot(pred_df, aes(x=x, y=predicted, color=group)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high, fill = group),
              alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  facet_wrap(~facet) +
  labs(
    x = 'Julian Day',
    y = 'Predicted bat occurrences',
    color = 'Light color',
    fill = 'Light color'
  ) +
  theme_classic()

effect_df <- pred_df %>%
  select(x, predicted, group, facet) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = group,
    values_from = predicted
  ) %>%
  mutate(effect = W-R)

p2 <- ggplot(effect_df, aes(x = x, y = effect)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = 'dashed') +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) + 
  facet_wrap(~facet) +
  labs(
    x = "Julian Day",
    y = 'Effect of White Light (White - Red)'
  ) + 
  theme_classic()

library(patchwork)
p1 / p2


data_env <- data_env %>%
  mutate(
    treatment = paste(color, intensity, sep='_')
  )

ggplot(data_env,
       aes(x = treatment, y = detections)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_classic()

summary_df <- data_env %>%
  group_by(color, intensity) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_occ = mean(detections),
    se = sd(detections)/sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(summary_df, aes(x = factor(intensity), 
                       y = mean_occ,
                       color = color,
                       group=color)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(ymin = mean_occ -se,
        ymax = mean_occ +se),
        width = 0.1
  ) +
    theme_classic()

ggplot(data_env, aes(color, detections)) + 
  geom_boxplot() + 
  labs(
    x = "Light color",
    y = "Bat count"
  )

ggplot(data_env, aes(intensity, detections, color = color)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = 'lm') +
  labs(
    x = "Light intensity",
    y = "Bat count"
  )

summary_df <- data_env %>%
  group_by(color, intensity) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_count = mean(detections, na.rm = TRUE),
    se = sd(detections, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(summary_df, aes(intensity, mean_count, color = color, group = color))+
  geom_line() +
  geom_point(size=3) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = mean_count - se,
      ymax = mean_count + se
    ),
    width = 0.1
  )
```

```{r}
source("04_Occurrence_Thresholds.R")

occurrences <- run_thresholds(data_env, thresholds = c(30, 60, 120, 300))

glimpse(occurrences)

occurrences %>%
  ggplot(aes(threshold_sec, occurrences, group = site, color = site)) + 
  geom_line(alpha = 0.3)

occurrences %>%
  group_by(threshold_sec) %>%
  summarise(total_occurrences = sum(occurrences))

data_30 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 30)

data_60 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 60)

data_120 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 120)

data_300 <- occurrences %>%
  filter(threshold_sec == 300)

site_env <- data_env %>%
  distinct(site, pct_forest)

occurrences <- occurrences %>%
  left_join(site_env, by = "site")
```

```{r}

data_env %>%
  count(site, species) %>%
  arrange(desc(n)) %>%
  head()

data_env %>%
  summarise(
    min_time = min(time_sec),
    max_time = max(time_sec),
    n_unique_times = n_distinct(time_sec)
  )

data_env %>%
  arrange(site, species, time_sec) %>%
  group_by(site, species) %>%
  summarise(
    min_gap = min(diff(time_sec), na.rm = TRUE),
    max_gap = max(diff(time_sec), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```

```{r}
source("06_run_models.R")
models <- run_models(data_env)

AIC(m0,m1,m2)

anova(m0,m1)
anova(m1,m2)

sim <- simulateResiduals(m2)

plot(sim)

testDispersion(sim)

testZeroInflation(sim)

summary(models$m2)
```

```{r}

library(glmmTMB)

m_30 <- glmmTMB(
  occurrences ~ 1 + (1|site),
  data = filter(occurrences, threshold_sec == 30),
  family = nbinom2()
)

m_60 <- glmmTMB(
  occurrences ~ 1 + (1|site),
  data = filter(occurrences, threshold_sec == 60),
  family = nbinom2()
)

m_120 <- glmmTMB(
  occurrences ~ 1 + (1|site),
  data = filter(occurrences, threshold_sec == 120),
  family = nbinom2()
)

m_300 <- glmmTMB(
  occurrences ~ 1 + (1|site),
  data = filter(occurrences, threshold_sec == 300),
  family = nbinom2()
)

AIC(m_30, m_60, m_120, m_300)

bind_rows(
  broom.mixed::tidy(m_30) %>% mutate(threshold = 30),
  broom.mixed::tidy(m_60) %>% mutate(threshold = 60),
  broom.mixed::tidy(m_120) %>% mutate(threshold = 120),
  broom.mixed::tidy(m_300) %>% mutate(threshold = 300)
) 
  
  
```

```{r}

sky_brightness <- read.csv(
  "sky_brightness_measurements.csv"
)


sky_brightness <- sky_brightness %>%
  mutate(
     file_name_clean = 
        tools::file_path_sans_ext(filename),
     site = 
        stringr::word(file_name_clean, 2, sep = "_"),
  )

sky_brightness <- sky_brightness %>%
  mutate(site = toupper(site))

sky_brightness <- sky_brightness %>%
  group_by(site) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_brightness_site = mean(mean_brightness, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

data_env <- data_env %>%
  left_join(
    sky_brightness,
    by = "site"
  )

```
